strings.proposals: Capture keys send events. Agent keys read this project’s evidence and submit inert grouping proposals; decisions and apply require the owner. Deploy keys only register releases and upload source maps for this project.
strings.native: Sentry events can arrive without a release or automatically create one. Native v1 still requires a registered release and build. An omitted dist has a separate no-dist identity; an explicit dist is kept distinct.
enableLines: Enable chunk and dynamic import failures
Enable client ip addresses and cidrs
